content: Ekkema cha Simeọn
Wa ose kw'ottong afa ode kw'ekkema ch'anọng p'ẹkhọma cha Simeọn, atzori ka nnọmma sabẹ. Wa ekkema chabẹ ewobh k'ottem kw'ẹkhọma cha Juda.
Wa ch'ẹttar: Beershẹba (kw'obiro okpena Sheba), ọmaana Molada,
ọmaana Hazar-Shual, ọmaana Bala, ọmaana Ezem,
ọmaana Eltolad, ọmaana Betul, ọmaana Họrma,
ọmaana Ziklag, ọmaana Bet-Markabot, ọmaana Hazar-Susa,
ọmaana Bet-Lebaot, ọmaana Sharuhen, kw'osi idedenmon jobh obhiri ittaan, ttara abhobhona pabẹ.
Iwa obiro ode ibhon s'Ayin, ọmaana Rimọn, ọmaana Ẹtẹr, ọmaana Ashan, kw'osi idedenmon inna ttara abhobhona pabẹ,
ọmaana abhobhona biphyir p'akhọri ibhon nna maa, apyiri Baalat-Beer (kw'ode Rama kw'okhubha kwa Nẹgẹv). Ma wọ iwa ode ekkema ch'anọng p'ẹkhọma cha Simeọn, atzori ka nnọmma sabẹ.

Wa ekkema ch'anọng p'ẹkhọma cha Simeọn, efon k'ekkema ch'anọng pa ẹkhọma cha Juda, okhuri da iwa ekkema ch'anọng pa Juda ebari ẹyọhnga k'odem kwa bẹ arori. Mando kw'iwa anọng p'ẹkhọma cha Simeọn atzọk ekkema chabẹ k'ottem kw'ẹkhọma cha Juda.
Ekkema cha Zebulun
Iwa ose kw'ottong attaan ode kw'ekkema ch'ẹkhọma cha Zebulun, atzori ka nnọmma sabẹ: Wa enem ch'ekkema chabẹ etzim maa, epyiri ka Sarid.
Achin k'okhubha kw'ewuchen em-edimi, chẹ etzim maa, epyiri ka Marala ẹtza ẹkwọhkhi ka Dabeshet, etzima epyiri k'ittolim s'ibaang Jokneam.
Wa chẹ ẹbhakhi k'okhubha kw'ewuchen em-eyin ka Sarid ekkeri ekpebha-kpikhira itzitzikha, k'okhubha kwa Kislọt-Tabor, etzima echina ka Daberat, yina en-evur echina ka Japhiya.
Ebire etzima mẹ echina k'okhubha kw'ewuchen em-eyin ka Gat-Hepher, ọmaana Et-Kazin; yina en-eyini ka Rimọn ẹbhakhi echina ka Nea.
Enem nda ẹkhọri echina k'ebir-ebira kwa Hanaton, etza ekponga k'Ittolim s'Iphta-Ẹl.
Ibhon s'ittar mẹ ide Katat, ọmaana Nahalal, ọmaana Shimrọn, ọmaana Idala ttara Bẹtẹlẹhẹm, kw'osi idedenmon jobh obhiri ifa ọmaana abhobhona pabẹ.
Iwa idedenmon nna ọmaana abhobhona pabẹ, bọ ade ekkema cha Zebulun, atzori ka nnọmma sabẹ.
Ekkema ch'Isaaka
Iwa ose kw'ottong anna ode kw'ekkema ch'anọng p'ẹkhọma ch'Isaaka, atzori ka nnọmma sabẹ.
Nnem sabẹ nttar: Jẹzrẹl, ọmaana Kesulọt, ọmaana Shunẹm,
ọmaana Hapharayim, ọmaana Shiyọn, ọmaana Anaharat,
ọmaana Rabit, ọmaana Kishiyọn, ọmaana Ebez,
ọmaana Remet, ọmaana Ẹn-Ganim, ọmaana Ẹn-Hada ttara Bet-Pazez.
Wa enem nda etzim ẹtza ẹkwọhkhi ka Tabọr, ọmaana Shahazuma ttara Bẹt-Shẹmẹsh, ẹtza ekponga ka Jọrdan, kw'osi idedenmon chi obhiri wani ttara abhobhona pabẹ.
Iwa idedenmon nna ọmaana abhobhona pabẹ, bọ ade ekkema ch'anọng p'ẹkhọma ch'Isaaka, atzori ka nnọmma sabẹ.
Ekkema ch'Ashẹr
Iwa ose kw'ottong azen ode kw'ekkema ch'anọng p'ẹkhọma ch'Ashẹr, atzori ka nnọmma sabẹ.
Wa okhubha kwabẹ ọttar: Helkat, ọmaana Hali, ọmaana Beten, ọmaana Akshaph,
ọmaana Alamẹlẹk, ọmaana Amad ttara Mishal. Wa enem nda k'okhubha kw'ewuchen em-edimi, etzim ẹtza ẹkwọhkhi ka Karmẹl ọmaana ka Shihor-Libnat.

Chẹ ẹtza ẹbhakhi k'okhubha kw'ewuchen em-eyin, da achin ka Bẹt-Dagọn, ẹtza ẹkwọhkhi ka Zebulun ọmaana k'Ittolim s'Iphta-Ẹl, etzima echina k'ebir-ebira kwa Bẹt-Emek ọmaana Neiyẹl, akwọbh Kabul ka kwabọhk.
Etzima echina k'Abdọn, ọmaana Rehob, ọmaana Hamọn ttara Kana maa, epyiri ka Sidọn kw'ideden.
Wa enem nda ebire ẹbhakhi ẹkpa nnam echina ka Rama, ebire etzima echina k'ọfha-bhon kwa Tyrẹ, ẹbhakhi echina ka Hosa ẹtza eyin k'Ọraanga kw'ideden kwa Mediteraneya k'ẹkhọma ch'Akzib
ọmaana Uma, ọmaana Aphek ttara Rehob, kw'osi idedenmon ẹrọbh obhiri ifa ttara abhobhona pabẹ.
Iwa idedenmon nna ọmaana abhobhona pabẹ, bọ ade ekkema ch'anọng ẹkhọma ch'Ashẹr, atzori ka nnọmma sabẹ.
Ekkema cha Naphtali
Iwa ose kw'ottong azadani ode kw'ekkema ch'anọng p'ẹkhọma cha Naphtali, atzori ka nnọmma sabẹ:
Iwa enem chabẹ ẹttẹwọr ka Heleph, ọmaana k'echi ch'ideden ka Zananim, akwọbh Adami-Nekeb, ọmaana Jabnẹl da achin ka Lakum, ẹtza ekponga ka Jọrdan.

Wa enem nda etzim echina k'okhubha kw'ewuchen em-edimi k'Aznot-Tabor, ẹtza eyin ka Hukok. Wa ẹkwọhkhi k'ẹrakh-ẹrakha kwa Zebulun, ọmaana k'okhubha kw'ewuchen em-edimi k'Ashẹr, ttara k'okhubha kw'ewuchen em-eyin ka Jọrdan.
Wa idedenmon sa bẹ atzim abaakha akhọri ide Zidim, ọmaana Zer, ọmaana Hamat, ọmaana Rakat, ọmaana Kineret,
ọmaana Adama, ọmaana Rama, ọmaana Hazọr,
ọmaana Kẹdẹsh, ọmaana Edreyi, ọmaana Ẹn-Hazọr,
ọmaana Irọn, ọmaana Migdal-Ẹl, ọmaana Horẹm, ọmaana Bet-Anat ttara Bet-Shẹmẹsh, kw'osi idedenmon ọhawani kw'ẹrọbh, ọmaana abhobhona pabẹ.
Iwa idedenmon nna ọmaana abhobhona pabẹ, bọ ade ekkema ch'anọng p'ẹkhọma cha Naphtali, atzori ka nnọmma sabẹ.
Ekkema cha Dan
Iwa ose kw'ottong azenamfa ode kw'ekkema ch'anọng p'ẹkhọma cha Dan, atzori ka nnọmma sabẹ.
Ekkema chabẹ ẹttar: Zora, ọmaana Ẹshtaol, ọmaana Ir-Shemes,
ọmaana Shalabin, ọmaana Aijalọn, ọmaana Itla,
ọmaana Elọn, ọmaana Timna, ọmaana Ekrọn,
ọmaana Elteke, ọmaana Gibeton, ọmaana Balat,
ọmaana Jehud, ọmaana Bene-Berak, ọmaana Gat-Rimọn,
ọmaana Me-Jarkon ttara Rakon, ttara k'okhubha kw'okkeri Jọpa.

(K'ogbe kw'iwa attattaanga-nọng p'anọng pa Dan akk'bẹ irerek sabẹ abọkha ana, anọng pa Dan afona atza arima anọng pa Leshem abẹ. Bẹ atzima akkangkkaang afhu bẹ, atzọkha obhon kw'anọng pa Leshem aruk. Wa bẹ an-atzọkha obhon kwa Leshem akpẹ-ẹ abhina Dan, kw'ode che ch'otte kwabẹ kw'ideden).
Iwa idedenmon nna ọmaana abhobhona pabẹ, bọ ade ekkema ch'anọng p'ẹkhọma cha Dan, atzori ka nnọmma sabẹ.
Ekkema cha Joshua
K'ogbe kwa bẹ akk'ekkema ch'irerek nna ka ngọma sabẹ akyera, anọng p'Israẹl an-anang Joshua kw'ode nnwa kwa Nun ekkema chẹ k'ottem kwabẹ,
mach'iwa Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi okk'obena. Wa bẹ anang-ẹ obhon kwa Timnat-Sera kw'ophyemi bẹ, k'okhubha kwa mgbegbeho s'Ephraim. Wa Joshua osi obhon mẹ, oruk.

Ma wọ ode ibhon s'iwa Eleazar kw'ode ọfọhnẹja, ọmaana Joshua kw'ode nnwa kwa Nun ttara adeho pa ngọma s'Israẹl, areng k'ose atzọkha ka Shilo, k'itzitzikha s'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, k'ẹbaakhamma ch'ikhira s'etzobha ch'Ibinọkpaabyi. Iwa bẹ akyera irerek nna okkekkema.
